title: FootPrint in ML: public story export
target: Static relative-path deployment; repository and hosting configuration are external to this package.
hashScope: files hashes cover published bytes. originalRetainedSource hashes cover private retained authoring inputs. The manifest itself is intentionally excluded from its own hash list. These checksums are integrity references, not signatures.
projection: Only local path strings, repository-document link targets and publication-specific source/checksum descriptions are changed. Logical recorded digests, model IDs and numerical claims are retained.
limits: Static/link/script validation only; browser interaction and deployed Pages URL should be checked after integration.
Local original evidence is not published verbatim for the path-projected JSON copies.
The ML implementation and numerical trainers are not executed by this package.
